moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-icon-swap, written here): Square button 56x56 r16, outlined; fill → accent over 0.6-0.8 s. Plus (22 px, 4 px stroke) scales 1 → 0 and rotates 0 → 90° over 0.55-0.75 s power2.in; the check scales 0 → 1 and rotates −90° → 0 over 0.68-0.98 s back.out, same centre. Reverse at 1.95-2.38 s (check out, plus in rotating back from −90°). Labels ADD → ADDED. Cursor clicks at 0.45 s and 1.85 s. Params: out (0.2 s, power2.in) · in (0.3 s, back.out, chồng 0.07 s) · rotate (90°) · fill (0.2 s).
